BiblicalUsage: Pele is a wonder, a miracle — the word for what only God can do. Moses sang that the LORD is glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders; the psalm calls Him the God that doeth wonders. Isaiah says God will do a marvellous work that swallows the wisdom of the wise, and Daniel's angel asks how long it will be to the end of these wonders.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a wonder is God's signature: when He acts, the wise are silenced and the proud are confounded. I hold that miracles are not God's showmanship but His mercy — He does wonders so His people will know Him. And the question Daniel's angel asks is still mine: how long until the end of these wonders? The answer is in God's hand, and I can wait for it.
